name: Arcane Shackle
rationale: Ender focus fixes an anchor, Chain tethers the victim, and protective stonework contains the moving body.
clues: Outer Plinths hold protection seal, passage focus; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the first outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the third outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Obsidian motif follows blank inscription clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Protection seal follows obsidian motif clockwise.
Bound metal follows protection seal clockwise.
Chain motif follows bound metal clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Passage focus follows chain motif clockwise.
Blank inscription follows passage focus clockwise.
